summary: Example State wants a student-facing transfer credit portal for undergraduates before the Fall 2027 cycle. They run Banner on-prem with Slate and keep equivalencies in a Banner table plus TES. The registrar wants evaluated coursework written back to Banner eventually, but the admissions director is fine going live student-facing first.
